name: Spring Gothic
source:
"I dream of myself, taking Nica by the hand and leading her through the rainy streets of a desolate London. I see these roads broken and littered with cars, Kensington Park overgrown with weeds, Big Ben's clock tower fallen by the wayside—

Maybe others would think of this as eerie, but to me, this is the only way London could ever be beautiful: as a stage for just the two of us, on equal footing and with the sun as our only witness."

After months of flirting and sexting, Nica and Chun are finally meeting up for the first time in London. Nica is a up-and-coming trans retro game streamer, and Chun is a med student who is having cold feet over her workload. They have confided their deepest secrets to each other online, but can they understand each other offline?

[From [url=https://proflilyvn.itch.io/spring-gothic]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我梦见自己牵着妮卡的手，领她走过荒无人烟的伦敦，雨下在街道上。我看见路面碎裂，废弃的汽车散落各处，肯辛顿公园里杂草丛生，大本钟的钟楼倒在路旁——

别人也许觉得阴森，可对我来说，伦敦只有这样才可能美丽：它成了只属于我们两个人的舞台。我们平等地站在那里，唯有太阳见证。”

在网上调情、互发色情短信好几个月后，妮卡和春终于要在伦敦第一次见面。妮卡是一位崭露头角的跨性别复古游戏主播，春则是个医学生，繁重的学业压得她有些打退堂鼓。两人早已在网上互诉过藏得最深的秘密，到了线下，还能同样理解彼此吗？
